title: Akshara Brahma Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the Imperishable Brahman
summary: Krishna explains the nature of the soul, the supreme reality, and the importance of remembering Him at the time of death for attaining liberation.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् |
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः || ५ ||
verses.translation: And whoever, at the end of his life, quits his body remembering Me alone at once attains My nature. Of this there is no doubt.
verses.transliteration:
anta-kāle ca mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāsty atra saṁśayaḥ
verses.meaning: Anta-kale - at the end of life; Ca - also; Mam - Me; Eva - certainly...
